title: Secrets, Auth Security & Scanning
intro: Beyond Rails' built-in protections, production applications need a secrets management strategy, dependency scanning, and static analysis in CI. Rails encrypted credentials (rails credentials:edit) is the modern approach — encrypted with the master key, committed to the repo, different per environment. bundler-audit scans the Gemfile.lock against the Ruby Advisory Database for known CVEs. Brakeman is a static analysis tool that scans Rails code for common vulnerabilities — SQL injection risks, mass assignment issues, unverified redirects, and more. JWT security deserves its own treatment: the algorithm confusion attack (never accept alg: none), the difference between HS256 (shared secret) and RS256 (asymmetric), and why you must validate the audience and issuer claims. This page covers all three areas.
